_note: Target scores established by 5 Opus agents grading complete transcripts. Higher-=-better axes (直接性/具體性/一致性) shown as-is. 迴避度 and 語氣落差 stored as the FRAMEWORK convention (high=worse), derived from 100 - agent_transparency_score.
_composite_formula: 綜合透明度 = (直接性 + 具體性 + (100-迴避度) + (100-語氣落差) + 一致性) / 5

直接性.tsmc: Most answers address questions with concrete specifics (N3 margin, CapEx drivers, capacity timing), though pricing and SoIC-timing questions get deflected.
直接性.nvda: Jensen reliably connects answers to questions but often pivots into broad thematic 'compute equals revenues' narratives.
直接性.foxconn: Pre-submitted and live Q&A deliver concrete numbers (40% AI share, 30%+ CapEx growth, 80/20 GPU/ASIC mix) directly tied to what was asked.

具體性.tsmc: Wendell Huang's CFO answers are dense with hard numbers; C.C. Wei dilutes with qualitative responses.
具體性.nvda: Q&A and prepared remarks saturated with hard data ($68B revenue, $11B Networking, 9GW Blackwell, $700B hyperscaler CapEx).
具體性.foxconn: Consistent concrete signals throughout (NT$7.2 dividend, 52.9% payout, 24-26% tax rate).

迴避度_inverse.tsmc: C.C. Wei directly engages competition; standard IR hedging on customer/product names only.
迴避度_inverse.nvda: Jensen pivots hard sustainability questions into architecture narratives; Colette softer deflection on buyback.
迴避度_inverse.foxconn: Concrete numbers on dividends, tax, capacity, inventory; standard deflection on customer-specific projects.

語氣落差_inverse.tsmc: Prep + Q&A both convey high-confidence bullish tone; C.C. Wei consistently assertive across both.
語氣落差_inverse.nvda: Jensen + Colette maintain evangelical, supply-constrained-but-confident register throughout.
語氣落差_inverse.foxconn: Measured-positive tone in prep carries into Q&A; CFO openly addresses margin/tax already flagged.

一致性.tsmc: Q&A tightly reinforces every prep theme — N3/AI, high-end CapEx, 30%+ growth, margins.
一致性.nvda: Mantras (compute=revenues, agentic AI, Blackwell/Rubin, $700B CapEx) echoed almost verbatim.
一致性.foxconn: AI rack doubling, 40% share, 3%+ margin, vertical integration consistent across all answers.
